items.title: Scarecrow Raking Leaves
items.alt: A gray burlap-faced scarecrow in a russet knit cap and moss waistcoat gathers fallen leaves with a wooden rake.
items.description: A gray burlap-faced scarecrow in a russet knit cap and moss waistcoat gathers fallen leaves with a wooden rake. An original scarecrow illustration for personal designs and classroom seasonal activities.

items.title: Scarecrow Carrying a Lantern
items.alt: A straw scarecrow in a plum hood and indigo cloak carries a closed amber-lit lantern and a folded wool blanket.

items.title: Scarecrow with an Umbrella
items.alt: An upward-looking scarecrow in a yellow raincoat and blue rain boots holds an open patchwork umbrella above a small puddle.

items.title: Scarecrow in a Winter Scarf
items.alt: A straw scarecrow in a teal fleece-lined trapper hat and berry coat holds a long cream scarf beside a snow-dusted fence post.

items.title: Scarecrow Hanging a Birdhouse
items.alt: A linen-faced scarecrow in a green felt hat and mustard dress stands on a two-step stool to hang a wooden birdhouse from a low post arm.
